scope: Atom.Header property declarations only. Scope Unit Declaration claims continue to express containment through IS_CONTAINED_BY; no Scope Unit.Container/Parent property is introduced.
latest_decisions: IS_CONTAINED_BY and CONTAINS remain Relations for Formal Claims/MODEL; +> and <+ remain existing aliases with no new alias semantics.
For Atom instances, Header.Container is the sole stored containment value. It is not duplicated under Header.Relations.
Every Atom has exactly one Header.Container, including Scope Unit Declaration Atoms. Project Scope Unit instance has zero IS_CONTAINED_BY relations.
Header.Container value is either a full Scope Unit path or the base ID of its containing Atom; base Atom ID is the current default.
R2698/R2699/R2700 typed IS_CONTAINED_BY wrapper is retired only after all consumers migrate; this packet does not retire it.
format_gap: Current Scope Unit.Path specifies string elements and the full chain semantics but does not establish a canonical lexical serialization for one full path-valued Header.Container. Candidate uses the existing string primitive and states the two permitted forms in prose; no new format syntax is introduced.

candidates.change: Adds Container to the Atom.Header property inventory.
Makes the Atom.Header.Relations object optional while retaining its existing Relation-member definition.
Declares required single string value, its two existing forms and base-Atom-ID default in prose; does not add a Relation child/map or alias.

follow_up_dependencies.action: Rebase or retire old Header.Relations.IS_CONTAINED_BY references only after the new declaration and each consumer are updated; do not remove typed wrappers ahead of consumers.
Retain formal Claim/model Relation declarations and Scope Unit instance containment; ensure Scope Unit Declaration Atom Header.Container is treated as a different host-level fact.
